## About
We're a local auto recycler serving the Miami and Homestead areas. We specialize in late model foreign and domestic parts, and we keep a large selection of quality used parts at marked down prices.
It doesn't matter if you run a repair shop or a body shop, or you just need a part for your own car. We can help you find it, and customers across the country can get their parts from us too.
Customers have given us a 4.2 rating across 103 Google reviews, and a few mention how well we keep them informed along the way.

## Services
- Used parts locating: Tell us what you need and we'll use our parts locating service to track down the right used part for your car or truck.
- Late model foreign and domestic parts: Quality used auto parts and truck parts for late model foreign and domestic vehicles.
- Car parts across the country: Not nearby? Wherever you are across the country, you can expect to get your purchased parts without delay.

## FAQ
Q: Do you sell to individuals or only to shops?
A: Both. We work with repair shops and body shops, and we're glad to help anyone who needs a part for their own car.

Q: Do you offer Telecheck?
A: Yes, Telecheck services are available.
